slides.heading: 1 — Bezos is a CEO again
body: Prometheus, co-led by Jeff Bezos, just raised $12B at a ~$41B valuation — backed by JPMorgan, BlackRock and Goldman Sachs.
It's his first CEO role since leaving Amazon in 2021. He didn't come back for another chatbot.

slides.heading: 2 — It builds atoms, not text
body: Prometheus is building an 'artificial general engineer' — AI that designs and manufactures physical products, from first sketch to factory floor.
Think cars, rockets, machines — engineered by AI.

slides.heading: 3 — It's a pattern, not a one-off
body: The same week, Neura Robotics raised up to $1.4B at a $7B valuation — backed by Nvidia, Amazon, Qualcomm and Tether — to build humanoid robots.
The frontier is moving from screens to the physical world.

slides.heading: 4 — Why now
body: Software AI is getting commoditized — everyone has a chatbot. The real opening is applying AI to the physical economy: manufacturing, robotics, engineering, logistics.
That's where the next giants get built.

slides.heading: 5 — What it means for you
body: The next wave of AI businesses won't just write words — they'll design, build and move real things.
Watch physical AI: design tools, robotics, manufacturing software. Learn the tools early — that's how operators win.
